tokens.name: canvas
tokens.usage: The screen ground behind the card and the chrome (menu, counter, rail). Never a text colour.

tokens.name: card
tokens.usage: The flashcard surface, and the label colour on an `ink` fill (primary button): 11.1:1 light, 10.5:1 dark.

tokens.name: sunk
tokens.usage: A pressed-in surface: the hidden cloze, chips, secondary buttons, the progress track. Holds `ink` text (9.5:1 / 8.9:1).

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: Dividers inside the card and between list rows. Decorative only — never the sole edge of a control.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: The headword, glosses, example sentences and all body text. On `canvas`, `card` and `sunk`: ≥9.5:1 light, ≥8.8:1 dark.

tokens.name: ink-strong
tokens.usage: The counter numerals and nothing else — one step heavier than `ink` so the count reads first in the chrome. ≥12.6:1 on every ground.

tokens.name: ink-2
tokens.usage: Secondary text: readings, translations, the part-of-speech label, the counter total, near rail words. ≥4.67:1 on `canvas`, `card` and `sunk` in light; ≥4.84:1 in dark.

tokens.name: ink-3
tokens.usage: Disabled controls, a missing-audio disc, the cover's rungs, and far rail words that fade out. Below 4.5:1 on purpose: never for text a person must read.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Ruri (瑠璃), lapis: the one colour. The live dot beside the counter, the play disc and the focus ring. A fill and a mark; as text use `accent-text`. ≥4.6:1 on every ground light; ≥4:1 on `canvas` and `card` dark.

tokens.name: accent-text
tokens.usage: Ruri as text (an accent chip's label, a link). Light is `accent` itself (≥4.67:1 on `canvas`, `card`, `sunk`); dark is lightened to hold ≥5:1 on every ground.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: An icon drawn on an `accent` fill (the playing bars in the disc). 5.6:1 light, 3.2:1 dark: icons only, never text.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Destructive actions (delete) and a forgotten grade, always with its word. ≥5.9:1 light, ≥4.9:1 dark on every ground. Red against ruri's blue: the pair stays distinct under red–green colour blindness.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: The 2px keyboard focus ring, offset 2px, on every interactive element.

families.jp: "Noto Sans JP", "Hiragino Sans", "Hiragino Kaku Gothic ProN", "Yu Gothic", sans-serif

styles.name: headword
styles.usage: The word under study, one per card, centred. Up to two characters.

styles.name: headword-md
styles.usage: A headword of three or four characters.

styles.name: headword-sm
styles.usage: Five characters and longer, and phrases.

styles.name: rail
styles.sample: 今日 時間 東京 日本 午前
styles.usage: Words in the word rail above the card.

styles.name: example
styles.sample: 東京に行くことになっています。
styles.usage: An example sentence on the card.

styles.name: reading
styles.usage: The kana reading under the gloss.

styles.name: counter
styles.usage: Cards left today, top right of the screen.

styles.name: counter-total
styles.usage: The day's total under the counter.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Grades sync when you open the app.

styles.name: translation
styles.sample: I am supposed to go to Tokyo.
styles.usage: The translation under an example sentence.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Part of speech and other one-word tags, uppercase. Also chips at 11px.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gloss to reading; dot to counter.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Example sentence to its translation; chip gaps.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gaps between buttons in the grade bar.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Screen side gutter on a phone.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Between examples; rail to card.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding; headword to gloss.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Chrome to rail; card top to headword.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Large-screen gutters.

tokens.usage: The hidden cloze.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Menus and sheets.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: The flashcard.

tokens.name: radius-full

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: The flashcard only. Dark mode separates the card by tone, not shadow.

tokens.name: shadow-accent
tokens.usage: The play disc's ruri glow. Dark adds the soft halo ring.

tokens.usage: The live dot beside the counter.
